images.title: a blank medium is formatted, not an error
a clean log recovers its last committed state
a torn tail is ignored and the log is rewritten clean
a flipped payload bit stops the scan before that frame and everything after it
a hostile frame length is rejected before anything is read or allocated
a replayed older frame (valid checksum, wrong sequence) is not applied
two unreadable segments: fail closed, report unrecoverable, start empty
a header whose first frame never arrived is not a state
two valid segments: the higher generation wins and the stale one is retired
a torn compaction falls back to the still-valid old segment
a newer schema than this code knows is refused, not formatted over
a legacy schema-0 image is read (credentials get version 1) and rewritten as schema 1
a header with a bad checksum is not a segment
a segment whose first frame is a transaction, not a snapshot, is not a segment
a retired segment (magic cleared) is ignored
the current segment is damaged after the stale one was retired: no rollback to a state before the revocation
